instructions: Press their centre-backs when they play back to the keeper: #9 and #10 go, #8 jumps to their 6.
Back four step up together on every back pass.
Left back inverts into midfield in possession; #11 holds the width on the left.
First five seconds after we lose it: the nearest three press, no fouls in their half.
Corners: near-post flick first, #5 attacks the near post, #9 screens the keeper. Long throws from #2 in their third.
plan.title: Brighton way: build in a 3-2-5, press high, defend in a 4-4-2

targets.name: Press intensity (PPDA)
targets.description: Their passes in their own 60% of the pitch for each defensive action of ours there. Lower is a harder press.

targets.name: Defensive line height
targets.description: Out of possession, the average distance of our four deepest outfield players from our goal line.

targets.name: Team length out of possession
targets.description: Out of possession, from our deepest to our highest outfield player. Lower is more compact.

targets.name: Width in possession
targets.description: In possession, the distance between our widest outfield players.

targets.name: Possession
targets.description: Our share of the time the ball was in play.

targets.name: Counter-press regains
targets.description: Of the times we lost the ball, how often we won it back within 5 seconds.

targets.name: Set pieces: first contact won
targets.description: Of our deliveries into the box (corners, free kicks within 35 m, long throws), the share where we won the first contact.

targets.name: Defending set pieces: first contact
targets.description: Of their deliveries into our box, the share where we won the first contact (or nobody did).

targets.name: Running drop (any player)
targets.description: The biggest drop in ground covered per minute among our outfield players: each one's last 15' against his own first 30'. A player on for less than two thirds of the stretch, or for less than 20 of the first 30', doesn't count.

targets.name: Shape in possession
targets.description: The formation the device reads in possession, against the plan's.
